Maya: Heads-up — customer acme-prod reports embeddings coming back with length 1536 on hosted but 1024 on their Dedicated pool after a traffic shift. similarity search failing due to shape mismatch :thinking:
Tom H: That's odd. Any model tag change or quantization rollout?
Maya: No model change. Both sides claim model tag `open-embed-v2`. Routing table shows same alias.
Liam: Could be a batching/padding edge in the Dedicated runtime. Any recent batching kernel updates?
eng-oncall-bot: Deploy: dedicated-runtime v3.12 rolled 2h ago to us-west-1 (sha abc123).
Rachel: I can repro hitting the dedicated endpoint with concurrent small texts. Dedicated returns 1024 dims, hosted still 1536. Dumping headers and sample response now.
Maya: Customer shifted ~60% traffic to Dedicated via canary policy. They also had prefix caching enabled on their client pipeline.
Liam: prefix-cache + batching + quantization interaction = suspicious. Dimension change shouldn't happen from quantization alone though.
Tom H: Can you paste a minimal curl repro?
Rachel: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Routing: dedicated:pool-42" -d '{"input":["hello","world"],"model":"open-embed-v2"}'```
Rachel: sample dedicated response snippet: `{
  "data": [ [/* 1024 floats */], [/* 1024 floats */] ]
}`
support-bot: Customer ticket #23456 — includes logs, repro curl, and timestamp window. Billing note: they saw unexpected embed-meter counts spike while canarying.
Maya: Action plan: 1) Repro across hosted/dedicated 2) Audit dedicated runtime kernel changes (v3.12) 3) Check routing/alias mapping 4) Offer rollback/mitigation to customer. Assign Rachel + Liam. @Tom H please check billing meter events correlation.
Tom H: On it — pulling org usage delta and meter event logs for org acme-prod.
Rachel: Found suspicious change in `compact_kv_cache()` in the dedicated runtime patch — it runs during batched prefix handling. Candidate for rollback.
Liam: If prefix cache is the trigger, a quick mitigation is to disable prefix_cache for their canary (degrades throughput but avoids KV path).
Maya: Customer accepted temporary mitigation. Rachel to run rollback of the compact_kv_cache change in us-west-1 dedicated pools and open a postmortem.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2027-042 — pager duty notified.
Rachel: Rolling revert to v3.11 in us-west-1 dedicated pool now: `kubectl set image deployment/dedicated-runtime dedicated-runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:v3.11`
eng-oncall-bot: Rollback completed. Monitoring: embeddings dims back to 1536 for 15m window. CPU utilization +12%.
Maya: :thumbsup: Good catch. Next steps: add cross-runtime dimension parity unit test, add an automated billing sanity check during split routing, and postmortem with RCA. I'll author follow-ups.
